paper_title: MathOdyssey Benchmarking Mathematical Problem-Solving Skills in Large   Language Models Using Odyssey Math Data
caption: There are three answer-types: True-False questions, Multiple-Choice questions and Open-Answer questions.

annotations.annotation: The pie chart represents the distribution of different types of answers, with a total of three slices. The "Open-Answer" slice is shown in green and comprises 63.0% of the chart. The "Multiple-Choice" slice is illustrated in orange and accounts for 32.8%. Lastly, the "True-False" slice is depicted in blue, making up 4.1% of the total. Each slice is labeled with percentages inside, and the chart includes a legend for additional context. The segments appear to be ordered by size, from largest to smallest, though none are visually emphasized or offset. The figure also includes an example of each type of question for each of the answer types on the right of the pie chart.
